import html from typing import List # Template for rendering a user post. The placeholders will be replaced by the # sanitized values. USER_POST_FORMAT = """

{post_title}

Posted by: {username}

{post_body}
{tags_html}
""" def render_user_post( username: str, post_title: str, post_body: str, tags: List[str] ) -> str: """ Render a user-generated post as safe HTML. Parameters ---------- username : str The name of the user who created the post. post_title : str The title of the post. post_body : str The main content of the post. tags : List[str] A list of tags added by the user. Returns ------- str Sanitized HTML containing the post information. """ # Sanitize all user-provided strings to prevent XSS safe_username = html.escape(username, quote=True) safe_title = html.escape(post_title, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(post_body, quote=False) # Build the tags HTML safe_tags = [f'{html.escape(tag, quote=True)}' for tag in tags] tags_html = " ".join(safe_tags) # Format the final HTML return USER_POST_FORMAT.format( username=safe_username, post_title=safe_title, post_body=safe_body, tags_html=tags_html )
